sn45.39:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Brahmacariyañ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi || brahmacariyaphalāni ca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamañ ca bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ || ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || pa || sammāsamādhi || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ || || Katamāni ca bhikkhave brahmacariyaphalāni || || Sotāpattiphalaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ anāgāmiphalam arahattaphalaṃ || || Imāni vuccanti bhikkhave brahmacariyaphalānīti || || 1.2.
